fields.statement: Verifier at fa388f90 (attempt 3). Built the binary in a scratch dir: `rhiza workflow check ship-change` is valid (builtin), and `workflow describe ship-change` shows landed-green and rebased-merge-green on.fail -> conflict-triage-landed -> rebase-merge-gate-failed, whose on.fail -> landed-infra-triage, on.pass -> landed-infra-wait, on.pass -> landed-green. The built-in's landed-infra-wait is `until rhiza ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra`, 6h timeout, 30s interval, max_visits 3. The earlier finding is fixed: the built-in landed-green now has max_visits 4 (1 + the wait's 3 returns). TestShipChangeLocalGate asserts that cap, and TestShipChangeLandedInfraWaitScript pins the script's copy of landed-green, landed-infra-triage and landed-infra-wait (caps, commands, routes) to the built-in. `go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/...` ok. `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-(landed-)?infra-wait'`: both PASS. run-ship-landed-infra-wait drives a landed run with a fake gh: landed-green fails, goes through conflict-triage-landed and rebase-merge-gate-failed to landed-infra-triage (pass), then landed-infra-wait, whose own --rerun-infra poll issues `run rerun 42 --failed` before the green. It then passes at landed-green visit 2, goes through gate-rebase-merge, rebase-merge, rebased-merge-green, merge (`pr merge 7 --squash --match-head-commit`), main-green and close-out, and the run succeeds. Read the diff: the code change is the cap, its test and the script comment; HEAD fa388f90 is an empty review commit.
